pr_title: Fix popup position of color picker
pr_body:
Fixes #71066

The popup is horizontally centered below the button now, but if there isn't enough space to popup below, then it popups above if the button is in the bottom half of the screen. At least that's the behavior I find the most reasonable, but please inform me if I'm missing something here.
pr_comments: This bugfix leans on the enhancement side and isn't 100% safe. Should bump the milestone probably.

issue_context.title: Color Picker popups in wrong direction
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0 beta 10

### System information

Ubuntu 22.04.1 LTS

### Issue description

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85438892/211197815-c49eaa9d-03b5-45d9-bc50-9c25beb2244a.png)

Since the color is near the top of the inspector, I expect the color picker popup to appear below. However...

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85438892/211197827-5d35fa4d-0c92-4bd9-96fa-fdff512b9a09.png)

This is because there is no enough space to pop up below, so instead it pops up above, reckless of where the button is on the screen.

### Steps to reproduce

Click on a color button that is closer to the top of the inspector, but doesn't have enough space to popup below.

You can for example create a Control node and check it with its Modulate property. Might require a smaller screen though.

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A it's in the editor

review_comments:
You are kind of mixing different coordinate systems in a single equation here.
- `get_global_position()`: Canvas coordinate system of the containing Canvas
- `get_size()`: Local coordinate system of the `ColorPickerButton`
- `minsize`: Viewport coordinate system of popup
- `viewport_height`: Viewport coordinates of the containing Viewport (actually I am not entirely sure about that one)

In the editor this is in many cases not a problem, but can you please test this in settings with non-default scales?

Already did, doesn't seem like a problem. How can I make the code better though?

1st condition meaning: If the y_pos of the button, plus the height of the button, plus the height of the popup (so y_pos of the bottom of the panel) is beyond the viewport height, then there's not enough space below.

2nd condition meaning: If the button is below the middle of the screen, then multiplying its y_pos by 2 will go under the viewport, so that way we check it's in the bottom half of the screen.

Here is a MRP for stress-testing: [BugColorPicker.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/10538275/BugColorPicker.zip)

I can have a look at the implementation regarding improvements, but unfortunately not right away.

Aw, I kind of completely forgot this is a user-exposed thing. I'm honestly not sure what users would expect from it when they use it in their projects. But from a first glance at your test project, it doesn't look more broken than before IMO
So it could be a valid approach to fix the editor-issue now and take care of the user-exposed problems at a later time.
